thread:
maya: Heads up — March invoice for Acme looks wrong. Missing reserved capacity line and support fee appears doubled. Invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-4832. batch=billing-batch-20260301-17

ravi: Ugh. Is this the reissue run or the original? @maya can you paste the invoice payload? :eyes:

maya: original run. attaching minimal snippet — looks like reserved_capacity line not emitted and support_fee duplicated.

maya: ```json
[
  { \"code\": \"compute\", \"amount\": \"1200.00\" },
  { \"code\": \"support_fee\", \"amount\": \"250.00\" },
  { \"code\": \"support_fee\", \"amount\": \"250.00\" }
]
```

finance-bot: Billing job billing-batch-20260301-17 failed at step \"lineitem-emit\" with error: KeyError('reserved_capacity') — retry scheduled (attempt 2).

olga: That explains missing line. The duplicate support fee could be a retry that partially completed and then re-emitted support fee without idempotency key. Do we have idempotency keys on the line emitter?

samir: Not for that legacy emitter. There's an open PR to add idempotency but not deployed. In the meantime we should stop automatic reissues for that batch. Can someone run: `/billing pause-auto-reissue billing-batch-20260301-17`?

maya: Ran it. response: \"auto-reissue paused for billing-batch-20260301-17\" :white_check_mark:

ravi: OK. Next steps: 1) create credit for the duplicated support fee and add the missing reserved_capacity line to a manual reissue; 2) mark original invoice as \"do not reissue\"; 3) open incident to fix emitter idempotency. Agreed?

olga: Agree. I'll own the credit + manual invoice creation. Which GL code should credits use? finance wants 'CR-ops' for one-offs right?

maya: Use GL: credits:one-off:CR-ops. Also include note: \"missing reserved_capacity and duplicate support fee from billing-batch-20260301-17\".

olga: Creating credit now. Preview: 
```json
{
  \"credit_id\": \"CR-2026-03-ACME-001\",
  \"amount\": \"250.00\",
  \"reason\": \"duplicate support_fee (auto-reissue retry)\"
}
```

olga: Credit created \"CR-2026-03-ACME-001\". Issued to Acme, GL=credits:one-off:CR-ops. :white_check_mark:

ravi: Thanks. maya, can you reissue a corrected invoice after olga confirms credit posted? Please include reserved_capacity line of 600.00 and remove duplicated support fee. Use new invoice id INV-2026-03-ACME-4832-v2 and set \"replaces\": \"INV-2026-03-ACME-4832\"?

maya: Will do. Reissue in progress, hold on charging customers until v2 issued.

finance-bot: Manual reissue started by maya for INV-2026-03-ACME-4832 -> INV-2026-03-ACME-4832-v2

samir: Also opening a postmortem/incident ticket for emitter idempotency + retry logic. I'll assign to eng-payments and eng-runtime. Ticket: INC-2026-03-BILL-22.

maya: Reissue completed. INV-2026-03-ACME-4832-v2 created. It includes reserved_capacity 600.00, support_fee 250.00 (single). Reference credit CR-2026-03-ACME-001 applied.

olga: Confirmed credit applied and customer notified. Sent email to acct team to confirm customer-facing messaging.

ravi: Great. Leaving this thread open until emitter idempotency fix is merged. Thank you all. :pray:

samir: Patch submitted for idempotency keys (PR #2412). Added test for duplicate-line suppression. Target deploy to staging tomorrow.

maya: Closing operational loop here — invoice corrected, credit issued, auto-reissue paused. Reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
